comment: She was great. She is very kind, funny, and approachable. She really wants to see you succeed and will help you get there. The class structure is about 20-30 minutes of homework questions/new material and then the rest of the time is spent working problems at the board with a partner. Calc 2 is difficult but she made it very manageable!
Dr. Dumbaugh is a very caring professor who wants to see her students succeed. Her tests are hard and office hours are very helpful.

I am a dedicated student, frequently recognized as an exemplar. Yet, failing her course as a freshman continues to unjustly hinder my graduate and merit opportunities. Her teaching style and grading made the class punitive, not educational. This single grade unfairly limits me, equating my efforts with those who never took a test or attended.

Best math teacher I have ever had best person I have ever met best class I have ever taken. As a first semester freshman, she convinced me to be a math major. She is an angel on earth and I want to take every class forever with her.

Dr. Dumbaugh is the best math teacher I have ever had. I was very afraid of math as I had a weak background going into this class and was unsure if I would make it to the end. However Dr. Dumbaugh would always be avaliable to help twice a week for office hours and during class time. Take this class with her. I can't recommend her enough.

She's energized/encouraging & creates a community where we collaborate & move around. Lessons are online videos & homework is manageable. Class is reviewing homework & partner practice problems. She goes above & beyond explaining when we're trying to understand the basics. Others say our class is intense. Don't take her if you're a non-math major.

Dr. Dumbaugh is one of those professors you just remember. She is so sweet and caring towards her students it's insane. She is always in your corner and rooting for you to do amazing. She will help you get to where you need to be. Ignore the previous comment about her being biased towards men, she is not (he is just crazy.) Shes the best

Really good math professor and I thoroughly enjoyed her FYS. Her writing assignments were fair and very straightforward, and you could choose almost any subject matter to write your final paper about. The class does have a lot of reading and regular quizzes, but as long as you read the books beforehand you will not have an issue.
She just hates men and is extremely bitter and biased toward men.

I was unsure about this course at first, but I ended up enjoying the books we read as well as the class discussions. I loved learning about my classmates' research and sharing my own. My writing skills improved immensely and I shall never again use 'to be' verbs, lest Dr. D come after me with a red pen to reclaim them for more active language.

One of the best math teachers I've ever had. I finished with a thorough understanding of the material, and though I don't wish to become a math major, I certainly considered a minor because of this class. She cares deeply about her students and reminded us all of the beauty of math. She will definitely help you succeed if you put in the work.
She is a great professor for math! Glad to have her for my Calc 1.
Professor Dumbaugh is a fantastic teacher! Yes, there is a lot of hw but she more than makes up for it with her amazing teaching. She is clear and you know exactly what she expects from you.
Awful. No help to her students. Tried to fail students. Looked like she enjoyed failing students too. Do not take her. Very mean.

What would the Math Dept at UR be without Dr. Dumbaugh! She will break the most complex topics in advanced and abstract math down till it makes sense for everybody in the class. Taking a class with Dr. Dumbaugh makes you love math and being a math major!! She is such a unique human being with her funny anecdotes and her caring personality.

Dr. Dumbaugh is a great professor! I definitely feel I grasped the various concepts pretty well and clear thanks to her lectures. There's a lot of hw, but it prepares you well for the exams. She is very excited about the class, sometimes at a very annoying level, but I would still take her class, cause I did learn a lot!

Dr. Dumbaugh is among one of the most amazing professors I've ever had. She, herself, is an amazing person with a great personality. She is so dynamic. Lectures are always fun. And she cares about you and really wants you to do well. Homework is a lot but it helps preparing for the exams. She is a tough grader though.

She is one of the best teachers that I've ever had. I was dreading taking Calc and she made actually made me look forward to Math class. She is so sweet and caring and I consider her a friend. Work hard, do your homework, reach out to her and she will make sure you succeed. If I liked Math better, she would have inspired me to become a Math major.

I love Dr. Dumbaugh!!!! She is my favorite professor. She explains linear algebra extremely clear and makes you fall in love with math. She was always there to hep and always assist me during the office hour. Taking her class is really inspirational and I changed to be a math major.
Not an easy teacher by any means. Really nice person, but I had a lot of trouble following her lectures, and I am a pretty solid math student. Better off taking someone else.
I completely enjoyed her class and I like her. She explain clearly and is always there to help. She is an amazing person and a math historian.
Dumbaugh is literally the best math professor ever! She is really enthusiastic and her reading guides really help because they double as notes.
An absolutely amazing professor! She will help you with everything anytime you need! I adore her!
Like this professor. Put effort and the class will not be hard. Two bonus points every test. Homework is much. Read textbook carefully. Attendance is not mandatory.

She is the coolest professor in UR and she gives a bunch of extra credits. She is not only an amazing professor but she also loves reading books and even published one!!!! Definitely recommends her and you will get an A for sure.
Great teacher and willing to go the extra mile to help
Great teacher!! Funny and easy to listen to
I love Dr. Fenster! She makes even Calculus fun. She really cares about her students' success. YAAAAY
Dr. Fenster is a great professor!!! She really tries!

Amazing professor! She is incredibly enthusiastic and energetic, and she manages to make a horrifying subject like calculus quite manageable. She makes an effort to know and help her students as much as possible. She really forces her students to work hard. Please take her class!

I love her! An indispensable part of the math department. If you're willing to put effort into learning the subject, she will do everything in her power to help you succeed. A genuinely insightful thinker with a beautiful personality. Her enthusiasm is contagious. She is also a great source for life advice.

She is horrible. Pretty sure i had the same answers as some girls and she took off double the points for me. Went to extra help 3times a week and did extra work and she said I wasn't trying enough. She is honestly the worst teacher I have had at UR. The math department is terrible in general. AVOID her.

HARD, and VERY DEMANDING. She thinks that the only class you are taking is her's. Expect to study hours a day and then 5 hrs a day for a week to get a B on a test. She thinks she is the greatest teacher, she is OK. LOTS of work and studying, do not going in thinking an easy A. Must do tons and tons of extra work to succeed in her class.

Dr. Fenster is my favorite professor at UR. Calculus is a difficult subject, and Dr. Fenster went out of her way to make sure I understood every concept. She was very easy to approach for help. I went to her office hours every day. She definitely made my calculus experience a good one. I highly recommend her class to anyone.

If you haven't taken a calc class in a while, do not expect to do well with her.  She teaches with this idea in her head that just because she says something once and wrote it on the board that it is just engrained int your brain. If you are a math person you'll love her, if not be careful.

Hands down, THE most INCREDIBLE teacher at Richmond. She is hard, but if you put in the effort she will make sure your grade reflects it. Always available for extra help, does move fast, but makes the material understandable. She loves her students like her children & learns everyone's names within the first week. Incredible human being,def takeher

One of my favorite professors at UR. She moves very quickly but adds quirky comments to keep students interested. Homework is due every class but only a few problems are graded and she answers questions. Such an interesting woman if you care to hear her out. Highly recommended.

By far the best professor at UR. She goes over all of your questions and is really enthusiastic about math. She really cares about her students and wants them to see them succeed. She does take up homework every class but it helps overall and she drops a couple of them. The tests are fair and there arent any surprises.

Horrible teacher.  I can't even believe people would like Fenster as a teacher.  She writes and talks faster than anyone I know, grades all homework assignments and is really strict about work done (also meaning that you get points off twice if you don't understand something b/c of quizzes), and talks about irrelevant topics in class. Horrible.
great teacher! all hw assgts are graded, but she drops like 5 at the end. really strict about not accepting late assgts tho. tests are a little lengthy, but manageable. definitely recommed her!
Great professor!  So helpful!  Engaging class discussions.  Get her for any class possible.
She's got a great heart...really likes to read stories and talk about her kids. She's a good teacher with good intentions and inspired me to pursue a math related major.
So nice, so smart, so helpful, so hard!

I'm going to be as staight as i can. I HATED MATH BEFORE HER CLASS AND NOW I LIKE IT.  She is one of the msot fair professors i have ever had.  She is also very helpful.  If you have the chance to have her do not hesitate.  She is honestly the best math teacher i have ever had. I CALL IT FENSTER LOVE

Aight, look, i'm gonna give it to u straight.  Della is shaweeet!!  The kid a few spots below summed it up with $$ in the bank.  She's so helpful, wants you to succeed.  There is HW every class that is graded, but it only helps.  Shes fair, nice, NICE, and really wants you to build a future- and she's there to flat out back u up.  TAKE D-Sizzle NOW
the best teacher I've even had. She really cares about her students and tries her best to help you succeed, I definitely recommend her!

Do not take this professor if you are interested in math. She speaks faster than any professor I've heard before, and writes twice as fast.Her tests are 5 questions on the hardest problems with no buffer questions. The one thing I did well on was the stuff I knew before taking the class, but dont worry that wasn't on the test. every hw is graded.

Great teacher, she cares about everyone and is very enthusiastic.  She's pretty much money in the bank.  Very approachable and likes to get to know her students on a personal basis...take a class with her now

Probably the best math teacher I've ever had.  She really cares that everyone understands the material and knew everyone's name by the second class.   She is very enthusiastic about learning in general. She gets upset when there is a lack of effort.  Tests are fair.
